1326|e69bef2b.name: Sloan McCoy
1326|e69bef2b.text: Speak quietly and with great care, the wrong word in these parts could get your throat cut. Now, what is it you need from me?

3595|fed57ab8.name: Shanda
3595|fed57ab8.text: My wisdom is yours, as is my knowledge. What can I do for you, $N?

918|08830bac.name: Osborne the Night Man
918|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

918|a0b51800.name: Osborne the Night Man
918|a0b51800.text: You look like the type I should watch my coin purse around. Something I can help you with?

2205-complete.name: Master Mathias Shaw
2205-complete.text:
You found me - and by looking at you, I'd say the run and subsequent search may have been a great strain on your system, both mentally and physically.

Would you like Renzik to show you the way to an inn or are you ready for some work?
2205-complete.title: Seek out SI: 7

2206-accept.name: Master Mathias Shaw
2206-accept.text:
Our operatives in the field are reporting heavy Defias activity south of Goldshire. The reports indicate that the Defias have taken over Jerod's Landing and are now using it as a way to smuggle large quantities of contraband from Redridge to Westfall.

I need you to infiltrate the dock house and get me that shipping schedule, $N. You will probably find it buried deep in the pockets of the Dockmaster.

...and $N, should you be discovered, SI:7 will disavow all knowledge of your existence.
2206-accept.title: Snatch and Grab

2206-complete.name: Master Mathias Shaw
2206-complete.text:
I am astonished... Astonished that Keryn finally found a recruit that could possibly have the makings of a proper $c. Take this blade, $N. A day will come when you will be called upon again to serve the SI:7. Hone your skills, keep your eyes open and that blade sharp.

You won't see us coming but you'll feel it when we get there...
2206-complete.title: Snatch and Grab

2206-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
2206-progress.text: Your mortality wanes with every moment you waste loitering in the barracks, $c.
2206-progress.title: Snatch and Grab

2281-complete.name: Lucius
2281-complete.text: Ah, so your fingers are a little fat, eh? Don't worry, $N, I've turned more useless thieves than you into accomplished rogues.
2281-complete.title: Redridge Rendezvous

2282-accept.name: Lucius
2282-accept.text:
We've been training thieves here for years! After all, not every rapscallion is born with the grace and finesse of old Lucius.

Up off the road here you'll find Alther's Mill. I got a chest up there with something important inside. Go get it for me! Bring back that token and you'll receive your Certificate of Thievery!
2282-accept.title: Alther's Mill

2282-complete.name: Lucius
2282-complete.text:
Cracked it open, did you? Nice work, $N.

If you die now, we can rest easy knowing it was due to your own stupidity and not inexperience.
2282-complete.title: Alther's Mill

2282-progress.name: Lucius
2282-progress.text:
Did I forget to mention the orcs?

I hear they have been nosing around up by the mill.
2282-progress.title: Alther's Mill

3119-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
3119-accept.text: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our $c trainer, Shanda. It seems Shanda would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to her afterwards.
3119-accept.title: Hallowed Sigil

3119-complete.name: Shanda
3119-complete.text: Do not concern yourself with the world below Teldrassil for now. There will be time for that later. Go now and speak to the others in Shadowglen--they can tell you more about what events have transpired. Help them in any way you can, and anytime you feel you need more training, come back to me and I will teach you what I can.
3119-complete.title: Hallowed Sigil

3119-progress.name: Shanda
3119-progress.text:
It pleases me to see you've arrived so quickly, $N. Welcome.

As you've probably heard, all of Teldrassil is stirring with the comings and goings of travelers. Even members of the Alliance have even been allowed access onto Teldrassil's boughs in order to meet with other Kaldorei who prepare for the adventures ahead.
3119-progress.title: Hallowed Sigil

3521-progress.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-progress.text: Please, collect the ingredients, $N. Iverron needs our help.
3521-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-progress.name: Iverron
3522-progress.text: Oh... $N, I'm so glad you have returned.
3522-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

459-progress.name: Tarindrella
459-progress.text: Satisfy my suspicions, $N.  Bring to me 8 Fel Moss.
459-progress.title: The Woodland Protector

5622-accept.name: Shanda
5622-accept.text:
$N, you must travel to Dolanaar when your business here in Shadowglen is done. There, you will find Laurna Morninglight. She will instruct you further in the ways of Elune, and it is with her that you will earn your first garments denoting your station as a priestess of Elune.

Take care, and may you be protected in your journeys.
5622-accept.title: In Favor of Elune

916-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-progress.text: Did you gather the venom sacs, $N?
916-progress.title: Webwood Venom

917-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-progress.text: Have you been inside the Shadowthread Cave, $N?  Did you find a spider egg?
917-progress.title: Webwood Egg

97977-progress.name: Tarindrella
97977-progress.text: Don't worry about any larger totems you might find. I wouldn't know what to do with them if you found a way to get them!
97977-progress.title: Nature's Call

97979-accept.name: Shanda
97979-accept.text:
You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and shall become a great priestess of our goddess Elune. Her grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.

Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.

Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.
97979-accept.title: The Goddess Provides
